IF
HitpointsChanged(S_GOB_HappyTorturers_TortureRack_dae2b64c-f4c3-4e44-bc57-1a17ad17d3a6,_)
AND
GetHitpoints(S_GOB_HappyTorturers_TortureRack_dae2b64c-f4c3-4e44-bc57-1a17ad17d3a6,_HP)
AND
_HP<=0
AND
DB_GOB_TortureRackDestroyer(_Player)
AND
QRY_GOB_HappyTortures_AdventurerShackledAndAwake()
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)GOB_Torturers_Liberator_f14fc1ce-62c5-4eaa-a4c1-26c53daa8ef1, _Player);
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)GOB_TorturedAdventurer_State_Unlocked_34dbc4e3-6fdf-4154-aa2b-d51b553b3977);

PROC
PROC_BlockUseOfItem(_Character, (ITEM)S_TWN_CentralSquare_RitualDagger_2b07d6f1-d698-47e2-9531-500cbffd9853)
AND
NOT DB_TWN_CentralSquare_TookDagger(1)
THEN
DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Character, (ITEM)S_TWN_CentralSquare_RitualDagger_2b07d6f1-d698-47e2-9531-500cbffd9853, 0);
PROC_TWN_CentralSquare_StartAltarDialog(_Character);

IF
AddedTo(S_LOW_SerialKiller_NoteFromOrin_9c029a99-2636-4c19-9ff3-c7564a91cd35, _Player, _)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
NOT DB_PermaDefeated(S_LOW_Dolor_55837c0f-0171-4020-a4a3-dd6de7ffc134)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("LOW_FindBhaalTemple_SicariusNoteFromDolor")
THEN
QuestUpdate("LOW_FindBhaalTemple", "MurderTribunal_StealedPassphrase");
SetFlag(LOW_MurderTribunal_Knows_WordOfPassage_839150e6-d168-4c89-a980-68b9e9f60556);

PROC
PROC_GlobalFlagReactionAfterDialog((FLAG)WYR_Circus_State_CheckpointGainedAccess_6c332552-395f-6f80-a0e7-d2450ab0812d)
AND
NOT DB_Defeated(S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGuard_63ef213e-7a72-4126-9d5f-2f7d60ee9178)
AND
IsDestroyed(S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGate_243c4eaa-d26b-4eda-8c04-b1f00c4d7492, 0)
AND
NOT QRY_IsOpeneding(S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGate_243c4eaa-d26b-4eda-8c04-b1f00c4d7492)
THEN
Open(S_WYR_Circus_EntranceGate_243c4eaa-d26b-4eda-8c04-b1f00c4d7492);
